flashcard_questions.q: Any piece of content created by the media industry, such as a video, animation, website, game, or graphic.
Which method draws each frame by hand on transparent sheets, as used in early Disney films?
Special effects that are physical and created during production on set, such as make-up, prosthetics, pyrotechnics, and animatronics.

flashcard_questions.a: Visual effects that are added digitally after production using computer-generated imagery (CGI), green screens, and compositing.
Computer-Generated Imagery — the creation of visual content using computer software, often used to create realistic environments, characters, or effects in film and games.
